name: auteur
title_zh: 拒绝套版，从零长出整套网站设计系统
tagline_zh: 想要获奖级落地页或电影感滚动叙事？它把多屏产品当成一部片子来导，组件、状态、路由全在同一套风格里，不用你拼凑。
tagline_en: Want award-level pages or cinematic scroll? It directs multi-screen products like a film—every component, state.
desc_en: Design and build complete web experiences from scratch — award-level product and marketing pages, cinematic scroll-directed sites where the page is directed like a film, and multi-screen products (app, dashboard, admin, settings, onboarding, docs site) built as one design system with every component, state and route in one style. Use whenever the user wants to create or redesign a landing page, we
why_zh: 它不产出零散页面，而是先立设计系统再长页面。每个组件、状态、路由都同源同风格，像导演统管全片镜头语言。
why_en: It builds a design system first, then grows pages from it. Every state and route shares one visual language—like a director.
limit_zh: 只覆盖从零设计到前端实现，不负责部署上线；需要你提供明确的视觉偏好或参考方向，否则它会在风格上自行发挥。
limit_en: Covers design-to-frontend only, no deployment. Needs your visual direction or references; otherwise it improvises the style itself.
title_en: Grow a full design system, not a template patchwork
